settings.name: Arsalan Ali Sargana
settings.title: Software Engineer | Full Stack Python Developer | AI & Healthcare IT Specialist
settings.tagline: Building Scalable AI-Powered SaaS and Healthcare Applications
settings.bio:
I'm a full stack software engineer specializing in Python, FastAPI, and React, with a focus on AI-powered and healthcare-adjacent products. I care about clean architecture, secure systems, and interfaces that feel effortless to use.

Over the past few years I've shipped production systems ranging from AI trading signal platforms to clinic booking software, always balancing technical depth with real-world usability.

I'm currently open to internships, freelance engagements, and collaborations on ambitious AI and SaaS products.
settings.approach: I start from the data model and the API contract, then build UI on top of a system that's already correct. Ship small, test constantly, document as I go.
